title: Tentacool Dries Up, Then Comes Back

direction.premise: Tentacool can dry into parchment on a beach and still revive in the sea.
direction.audiencePromise: Watch Tentacool transform from a dried beach remnant back into a drifting sea Pokémon.
direction.openLoop: What happens when water returns to a dried-out Tentacool?
direction.payoff: The sea restores what the shore dried out, and Tentacool revives.
direction.engagementQuestion: Is Tentacool a survivor, or a Pokémon built around water?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan sharing a surprising Pokédex detail. Use quick, warm pacing with clear emphasis on dry, alive, and revives. Keep the final question genuinely debatable.

scenes.headline: DRY, BUT STILL ALIVE
scenes.narration: Tentacool can dry into parchment, and still be alive.
scenes.caption: DRIED OUT DOESN'T MEAN FINISHED

scenes.headline: DRIFTS IN SHALLOW SEAS
scenes.narration: Tentacool drifts in shallow seas, with a body largely made of water.
scenes.caption: ITS BODY IS LARGELY WATER

scenes.headline: WATER LEAVES. FORM COLLAPSES.
scenes.narration: When it washes ashore, that water-based body dries like parchment.
scenes.caption: ASHORE, IT DRIES LIKE PARCHMENT

scenes.headline: THE BEACH REMNANT LIVES
scenes.narration: Yet those dehydrated beach remains are often still alive.
scenes.caption: DEHYDRATED DOESN'T MEAN DEAD

scenes.headline: THE SEA REVERSES IT
scenes.narration: The sea restores what the shore dried out, and Tentacool revives.
scenes.caption: BACK INTO THE SEA, BACK TO LIFE

scenes.headline: SURVIVOR OR WATER-BUILT?
scenes.narration: Is Tentacool a survivor, or a Pokémon built around water?
scenes.caption: WHICH ONE FITS TENTACOOL?
